name: personal-finance-test-automation
description: Test automation framework for Personal Finance.

scripts.test:staging:destructive: npm run test:staging:preflight && TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=true E2E_WORKERS=1 playwright test --grep @destructive --project=api
scripts.test:staging:destructive:ui: npm run test:staging:preflight && TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=true E2E_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/ui --grep @destructive --project=chromium
scripts.test:staging:destructive:ui:ingresos: npm run test:staging:preflight && TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS=true playwright test tests/ui/ingresos-unicos.destructive.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:ui:review: E2E_TRACE=on E2E_SCREENSHOT=on E2E_VIDEO=on E2E_WORKERS=1 playwright test --grep @ui --project=chromium
scripts.test:staging:destructive:ui:review: E2E_TRACE=on E2E_SCREENSHOT=on E2E_VIDEO=on npm run test:staging:destructive:ui
